scope_policy: Track the remaining fixed engineering outcomes. Source-inventory coverage, isolated SPICE parity and release version numbers do not substitute for receiver or repair validation.

actions.evidence_dependency: Existing drawings may suffice; clearer source/chassis evidence only if the unresolved details remain ambiguous.
acceptance: Assign both 7C6 diode glyphs to socket pins 5/6.
Resolve the four-dot oscillator coupling symbol and complete its electrical representation.
Resolve #8 0.05/0.1 µF value conflict or retain a specifically approved variant.
actions.v055_review: Manufacturer basing identifies the two separate 7C6 diodes, but does not assign the unnumbered Philco glyphs to physical pins. No source-backed assignment or oscillator/#8 resolution is claimed.

actions.evidence_dependency: Manufacturer data, derivation and sensitivity work are actionable; some exact parameters need measurements or parts data.
acceptance: Validate models for all five tube types against manufacturer curves.
Establish coil/transformer L, coupling, winding resistance and output-transformer/speaker relationship.
Establish volume-control resistance/taper, field inductance and lamp/heater behavior; identify supported approximations.
completed_in_v055: Approximate manufacturer-derived 7C6 and 50L6 curve tables with typical-point/slope and separate graph checks.
Explicit transformer/volume/grid-current assumptions and transformer sensitivity scenario.
remaining_after_v055: Validate denser audio curves, grid-current and screen-scaling behavior.
Complete 7A8/7B7/35Z3 models and coil/transformer/pot/lamp/heater parameter validation.
completed_in_v056: Declare detector/source/volume parameters and compare both unresolved #8 values; no diode-curve or IF-winding calibration claimed.
completed_in_v057: Approximate Sylvania 7B7 plate/screen curve samples, typical-point and transconductance checks; declared interelectrode capacitances and winding assumptions.
remaining_after_v057: Correlate 7B7 screen scaling and full curve envelope, diode law and winding parameters; complete 7A8/35Z3/heater/lamp/field and existing audio parameter validation.
completed_in_v058: Replace generic winding DCRs with printed 31/29/45/6.8-ohm values; separate assumed core loss from copper loss.
Replace the zero-grid current-table clamp with a declared continuous positive-grid extrapolation and verify its numerical implementation.
remaining_after_v058: Correlate winding L/k/core loss, tube screen/positive-grid behavior, and remaining converter/rectifier/heater/lamp/field/audio parameters.
completed_in_v060: Add a separately identified RCA 1947 35Z3 model anchored at 20 V/200 mA and checked against seven withheld average-curve readings; retain the GE legacy reference as an explicit alternative.
remaining_after_v060: Complete remaining tube/winding/audio/field/heater/lamp correlation, including 35Z3 low-drop/high-current extrapolation and heater-dependent emission.

actions.action: Connect power supply to receiver loads
actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable with existing sources and models.
acceptance: Replace power-bench stand-in resistors with currents drawn by the actual receiver stages.
Validate rectifier conduction and heater/lamp behavior over supported supply conditions.
Check reservoir/filtered voltages, ripple, startup and discharge under healthy and faulty receiver loads.
completed_in_v055: Jointly solve audio plate/screen currents with the dynamic supply; no one-way rail feed.
Exercise healthy, coupling leakage, dead output, dry filter and field-open behavior.
remaining_after_v055: Replace the remaining RF/IF substitute demand with actual converter/IF stage currents.
Validate rectifier, heater, lamp and field behavior across supported line conditions.
completed_in_v057: Actual modeled 7B7 plate/screen currents load the same dynamic supply and #13/#11 screen network as the detector and nonlinear audio in the hot DC fixture.
remaining_after_v057: Replace remaining converter injection, plate and screen substitutes with the active 7A8. Validate full AC/DC, startup/discharge and heater/lamp/field envelope.
completed_in_v060: Carry the same rectifier selection through power, nonlinear audio and coupled IF supply currents and matching SPICE exports; validate loaded supply sensitivity and report curve extrapolation during startup and measurement.
remaining_after_v060: Replace converter substitute loads; validate full coupled-receiver AC/DC startup/discharge and heater/lamp/field envelope.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable with existing topology and manufacturer data; uncertain transformer/speaker values need bounded parameters.
acceptance: Model volume control, 7C6 triode, 50L6 output stage and output transformer/speaker.
Validate gain, bias, clipping, loading and hum transfer; make output respond to component faults.
completed_in_v055: Implement volume, 7C6 triode, 50L6, winding DCR/magnetizing L and reflected speaker load.
Exercise gain, bias, clipping, hum, mute, coupling faults and restoration under declared parameters.
remaining_after_v055: Correlate uncertain transformer/speaker, volume and grid-current parameters; validate frequency response and a broader operating envelope.
Connect audio behavior and faults to the shop receiver/inventory/jobs.
completed_in_v057: Detector-derived signal, triode grid loading, nonlinear audio and dynamic supply now share a single 26-variable MNA system in the IF receiver fixture.
remaining_after_v057: Correlate audio/transformer/speaker parameters and frequency envelope; connect validated receiver behavior to shop repairs.

actions.action: Complete IF, detector and AVC behavior
actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable in parallel with remaining diode pin mapping.
acceptance: Model 455 kHz IF transfer, bandwidth, tuned adjustments and stage loading.
Implement detector rectification, audio recovery and AVC attack/release/loading.
Verify responses to signal strength, misalignment and component faults.
completed_in_v056: Carrier-resolved two-diode detector/AVC subset with factory-traced #7/#8/#15/#17/#18/#19 and volume network.
AM audio recovery, AVC arrival/release, fault/restoration and selectable #8 sensitivity cases under declared diode/source assumptions.
remaining_after_v056: Active 7B7 stage, coupled/tuned IF windings, 455 kHz bandwidth/alignment and actual supply load.
AVC feedback to converter/IF gain; correlate diode/source parameters, grid loading and steady-state/long-duration behavior.
Join detector, nonlinear audio and supply in one loaded receiver model.
completed_in_v057: Active 7B7 and both coupled/doubly tuned IF transformers; detector/audio/supply mutual loading and AVC return through first IF secondary to the 7B7 grid.
remaining_after_v057: Correlate tube/winding/diode parameters and IF passband/alignment against supported evidence. Validate long-duration AVC attack/release/steady behavior; add converter AVC feedback when EC-06 is implemented.
completed_in_v058: Correct the second IF to its source-drawn single tuned secondary; independently control 12A/12B/14A.
Solve loaded complex IF response from the same MNA; validate passband sampling and repeatable 455 kHz fixture adjustment.
remaining_after_v058: Correlate the actual loaded passband and physical trimmer range; complete converter AVC feedback and long-duration AVC behavior.
completed_in_v059: Continue the same coupled IF/detector/audio/supply state through signal removal and one second of AVC release; verify timestep/ringdown convergence, both #8 alternatives, fault/restoration and independent SPICE continuation.
remaining_after_v059: Correlate tube/winding/diode parameters, actual loaded passband and physical trimmer range; validate long-duration AVC attack/steady regulation and converter AVC feedback.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable after the coupling symbol is resolved; additional schematics are not a general prerequisite.
acceptance: Implement oscillator/converter behavior and tracking across 540–1600 kHz.
Validate the 455 kHz frequency relationship, tuning/alignment effects and input behavior.
Check weak/dead oscillator and aerial faults against the receiver model.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable by defining repeatable model test conditions; historical conditions may require additional evidence.
acceptance: Connect meters, signal generator and tracer to authoritative receiver nodes with defined loading.
Record supply, control settings, signal and instrument conditions for each benchmark measurement.
Use historical voltage labels only where return/loading/conditions support comparison; distinguish simulated reference conditions.
completed_in_v055: Connect ideal, 10 MΩ/100 pF and 1000 Ω/V (250 V range) probes to explicit audio/power nodes.
Record supply, signal, volume, timing and instrument conditions; keep factory targets separate.
remaining_after_v055: Extend node access/loading to RF/IF/detector/AVC and shop instruments.
Verify historical measurement conditions where factory targets are used.
completed_in_v056: Five detector/AVC probe ports with ideal, 10 MΩ/100 pF and 1000 Ω/V (10 V range) loading; declared signal/timing/reference conditions.
completed_in_v057: Loaded probes on IF grid/plate, shared screen, supply, AVC and audio nodes in one coupled circuit; explicit DC/injection/timing/range conditions.
remaining_after_v057: Complete RF node/instrument and shop integration, then verify historical measurement conditions.
completed_in_v058: Define hot-DC infinitesimal current-injection conditions and measure probe loading on the coupled IF response.
remaining_after_v058: Complete RF/shop generator, meter and tracer integration; validate historical service measurement conditions.
completed_in_v059: Record removal/ringdown/release times and AVC/IF-grid/B+ checkpoints; measure ideal, 10 MΩ/100 pF and 1000 Ω/V AVC-probe loading.
remaining_after_v059: Complete RF/shop generator, meter and tracer integration; validate historical service measurement conditions.
completed_in_v060: Record selected tube reference and nominal-heater curve bounds in submitted circuit conditions; expose out-of-range conducting steps instead of implying full-envelope calibration.
remaining_after_v060: Complete RF/shop instruments and historical service conditions; nominal manufacturer heater conditions do not establish receiver calibration.

actions.evidence_dependency: Existing layout/photos support most work; exact hidden physical routes may need better photos or continuity.
acceptance: Map component endpoints and instrument access to the serviceable game chassis.
Resolve physical identities that affect faults, polarity or repairs.
Keep unsupported lead dress and chassis/B− bond claims explicit.

actions.evidence_dependency: Actionable after receiver stages and instruments are integrated.
acceptance: Establish a deterministic healthy-radio baseline over supported tuning/supply conditions.
Exercise a fixed fault matrix through diagnosis, part replacement, alignment and successful checkout.
Run regressions, record limitations and close the six agreed benchmark gates only when their acceptance evidence is met.
completed_in_v055: Deterministic audio/power healthy baseline and fault/restoration scenarios.
remaining_after_v055: Integrate full receiver stages and shop repair workflow.
Run the full diagnosis/replacement/alignment/checkout matrix and close all six gates.
completed_in_v056: Deterministic detector/AVC fault/restoration cases; full shop acceptance remains open.
completed_in_v057: Deterministic integrated IF-to-speaker hot DC baseline, fault/restoration and independent SPICE scenarios.
remaining_after_v057: Full RF receiver baseline and the complete diagnosis/replacement/alignment/checkout shop matrix remain open.
completed_in_v058: Exercise misalignment/three-control adjustment/recovered audio in the coupled IF/detector/audio/supply arrival fixture.
remaining_after_v058: Full RF receiver baseline and complete shop diagnosis/replacement/alignment/checkout acceptance remain open.
completed_in_v059: Add deterministic signal-removal, #17-open, no-signal and restored electrical release cases to the coupled receiver regression matrix.
remaining_after_v059: Full RF receiver baseline and complete shop diagnosis/replacement/alignment/checkout acceptance remain open.

next_integration_target: EC-01/06: close oscillator coupling interpretation and implement RF/converter tracking and actual converter currents.
EC-02/05: correlate remaining IF/tube parameters; validate long-duration AVC attack/steady regulation and converter feedback. One-second release is covered by the declared v0.59 fixture.
EC-03/04: validate the complete receiver supply/audio envelope.
EC-07/08/09: serviceable chassis/shop instruments and full repair acceptance.
milestone_completed: v0.60 supports EC-02/03/07 with a source-traced RCA 35Z3 alternative, shared solver/export selection, supply sensitivity and curve-coverage reporting. No full EC closes.
version_reporting_policy: Every release names the EC IDs it supports, the concrete evidence added toward closure, and any EC IDs actually closed. Support is not full closure; the nine acceptance lists remain fixed.

version_support.summary: Manufacturer-curve-checked 35Z3 alternative, shared circuit selection, loaded-supply sensitivity and explicit extrapolation reporting.
version_support.limitations: RCA curve checks apply to nominal 35 V heater and 5–40 V forward drop, not all PT-44 conditions. Converter substitutes, thermal/lamp behavior, other parameters and full shop/receiver acceptance remain open.

EC-02: Add a separately identified RCA 1947 35Z3 model anchored at 20 V/200 mA and checked against seven withheld average-curve readings; retain the GE legacy reference as an explicit alternative.
EC-03: Carry the same rectifier selection through power, nonlinear audio and coupled IF supply currents and matching SPICE exports; validate loaded supply sensitivity and report curve extrapolation during startup and measurement.
EC-07: Record selected tube reference and nominal-heater curve bounds in submitted circuit conditions; expose out-of-range conducting steps instead of implying full-envelope calibration.
